versions.guide:
Finding the barracks

The garrison Aiset-Bek will inspect is on the western river bank across the south bridge.

Approaching the gates

There is only one gate that leads to the barracks' courtyard.

Opening the gates

Just open them

Finding Aiset-Bek

Aiset-Bek is in the barracks' courtyard.

Killing Aiset-Bek

Aiset-Bek must pay for all his crimes!
versions.html:
Death to Aiset-Bek!

Aiset-Bek, a notorious and hated Head of the guards will inspect one of the garrisons. That provides a good opportunity to pay him back in full!
